targets.query: from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grid" and r._field == "import_kwh") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> difference() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
